hook: Your train in Goa rides right across a giant waterfall.
title: The Train That Crosses a 310 m Waterfall
description:
Dudhsagar Falls in Goa is a four-tier waterfall about 310 metres tall. A railway bridge crosses right in front of it, so passing trains share the view. Its name means sea of milk.

#Shorts #Goa #India
